'''Gupa-Abawa''' is a [[Nupoid language]] spoken in [[Niger State]], [[Nigeria]]. It is named after its two ethnicities, Gupa and Abawa.

Gupa is spoken in the villages of Gupa, Abugi-Jankara, Emirokpa, Favu, Kenigi, Kpotagi, Abete, Kuba, Avu, Dagbaje, Eji, Jihun, Yelwa, Cheku, Atsu,chepa, Alaba, Gbedu, and Kirikpo located to the south of [[Lapai]]. Lexically, it is most closely related to [[Kami language|Kami]] and [[Dibo language|Dibo]].<ref name="Blench2013">Blench, Roger. 2013. ''[http://www.rogerblench.info/Language/Niger-Congo/VN/Nupoid/Nupoid%20Overview%202013.pdf The Nupoid languages of west-central Nigeria: overview and comparative word list]''.</ref>
